title: LazyInitializationException on a lazy collection: wrap the service method in a read-only transaction
errorSample:
org.hibernate.LazyInitializationException: Cannot lazily initialize collection of role 'task.Order.items' with key '1' (no session)
    at app//org.hibernate.collection.spi.AbstractPersistentCollection.throwLazyInitializationException(AbstractPersistentCollection.java:647)
    at app//org.hibernate.collection.spi.AbstractPersistentCollection.withTemporarySessionIfNeeded(AbstractPersistentCollection.java:232)
    at app//org.hibernate.collection.spi.AbstractPersistentCollection.readSize(AbstractPersistentCollection.java:159)
    at app//org.hibernate.collection.spi.PersistentBag.size(PersistentBag.java:403)
    at app//task.OrderServiceTests.주문 상세는 주문 품목을 함께 돌려준다(OrderServiceTests.kt:20)
symptom: Reading a lazy @OneToMany collection from an entity returned by a service throws LazyInitializationException "no session".
cause: The repository call runs in its own short-lived session which is closed immediately, so any lazy proxy created by it is detached when the service method returns.
fixSummary: Annotate the service method that loads the entity with @Transactional(readOnly = true). The session then stays open for the whole method, and lazy collections of the returned entity load normally; no other change is required.
